create_sequence_logo: create a sequence logo plot from a 2D numpy array of letter heights for DNA bases ACGT
visualize_contact_map: visualize a contact map as a log-scaled heatmap with a custom fall colormap and colorbar
plot_genomic_track: plot a single genomic track as a line plot, sequence logo, or dual-strand plot based on array shape
plot_multiple_tracks: plot multiple genomic tracks as stacked subplots in a single matplotlib figure with shared x axis
create_sashimi_plot: create a sashimi plot of RNA-seq splice junctions with arcs and read count annotations on a matplotlib axis
